environment.description: Same firmware deployed on STM32H753 with TrustZone-M enabled. Secure partition (SPE) handles all cryptographic operations via PSA Crypto API; non-secure partition (NSPE) where MQTT handler runs has SAU/IDAU configured with region 0x20000000-0x2001FFFF as NS-callable boundary. ATECC608B secure element connected via I2C to secure world only (bus isolation via TZSC peripheral controller MPCBB configuration on SRAM2). The hw_crypto_decrypt() call is a veneer into secure world that validates ciphertext_len against monotonic counter in SE before decryption. Additionally, the MPU is configured with 8 regions: region 4 covers the session_buffer at 0x20004000 with size 4KB and XN+RW permissions, region 5 is a 32-byte guard page at 0x20005000 with no-access permission (triggers MemManage fault on overflow). Stack region 7 has limit register set. However, the MPU guard page only protects against writes PAST the buffer - the initial memcpy with a wrapped payload_length value of 0xFFFFFFF4 would attempt to copy ~4GB which hits the guard page at offset 4096.
